ruleDefinitions.name: Browser Execution In Headless Mode
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of Chromium based browser in headless mode

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-headless.*"))
